response.overview: In a sleepy little town where the ice cream parlour carries on day after day, a girl whose heart belongs to the theatre must decide whether she is willing to leave behind the love of her life to pursue her dream.  A mysterious elderly woman, the voice of Mephisto, and a girl who can no longer afford to put things off until tomorrow lead her towards a question she can no longer avoid:  How much of yourself must you give up in order to find yourself?
response.title: Das Rotkehlchen
